DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お店の設備についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about your shop's facilities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 店の入口に、毎朝出す看板を置きたいです。歩道に出してよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 店先看板を歩道に置く相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to put a sign outside the shop entrance every morning. I would like to ask whether I can put it on the sidewalk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about putting your shop's sign on the sidewalk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 看板の予定位置が分かる図はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a diagram showing the planned location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真です。店の壁から四十センチくらい出す予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定位置と壁からの距離を写真で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is a photo. I plan to have it extend about forty centimeters from the shop wall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the planned position and distance from the wall in a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩道にかかる可能性がありますね。道路の担当で、境界と手続きの確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It may overlap the sidewalk. The roads department needs to check the boundary and procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 敷地の境界が分かる書類も持ってきました。担当で見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 境界書類を担当に見せられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also brought documents showing the property boundary. Can the person in charge look at them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the person in charge can review the boundary documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。書類と写真をお持ちください。看板の寸法も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please bring the documents and photo. We will also ask the sign's dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 高さ八十センチ、幅五十センチです。閉店時には店内にしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 看板寸法と営業時間中だけ出す運用を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is eighty centimeters high and fifty centimeters wide. I will put it inside when the shop closes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the sign dimensions and displaying it only during opening hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その使い方も担当へお伝えください。こちらでは設置の可否は決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge that too. We cannot decide here whether installation is allowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 道路の担当で相談してから置きます。写真に寸法を書き足して持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 設置前に寸法付き写真で担当相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will consult the roads department before placing it. I will add the dimensions to the photo and take it along.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult before installation with the photo including dimensions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当窓口は奥です。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: The department's counter is farther inside. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の予定で、確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you want to check about today's schedule?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 午前に検査があるので、シャワーはそのあとに使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査後のシャワーを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an examination this morning, so I would like to use the shower afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a shower after the examination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査は十時です。午後の枠をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The examination is at ten. Would you like an afternoon slot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。一時ごろが空いていれば、その時間にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 午後一時の利用枠を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. If around one is available, I would like that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the one o'clock afternoon slot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一時は使えます。体調と検査後の指示を確認してから、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: One is available. We will guide you after checking your condition and post-examination instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 点滴があります。入る前に、腕の保護をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 点滴があり腕の準備を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an IV. Could you protect my arm before I go in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention the IV and request preparation of your arm. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入れる状態か確認したうえで、必要な準備をします。タオルはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check whether you can shower, then make the necessary preparations. Do you have a towel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。洗ったタオルを掛ける場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: タオルの所持を答え干す場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please also tell me where to hang the washed towel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have a towel and ask where to hang it to dry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ベッド脇のタオル掛けをお使いください。床に物を置くときは声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Use the towel rail beside the bed. Let us know when putting things on the floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: タオルを用意して掛けておきます。一時の前に、入れるか声をかけてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: タオル準備と利用前の声掛けを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will prepare the towel and hang it up. Before one, could you let me know whether I can shower?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the towel and request a check-in before use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらから伺います。では、またあとで。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we will come to you. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道路上で気になるものを見つけたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You found something concerning on the road, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。歩道に尖った金属片がありました。自転車の人も通る場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道の尖った金属片と利用者の状況を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There was a sharp piece of metal on the sidewalk. Cyclists also pass there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report sharp metal on the sidewalk and the people using that place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を詳しく教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give the location in detail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 郵便局の向かいで、横断歩道から三メートルほど先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 横断歩道からの距離を含め場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opposite the post office, about three meters beyond the crosswalk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the location including the distance from the crosswalk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きさと、どのような形か分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know its size and shape?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手のひらくらいの板で、一方の端が上に曲がっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金属片の大きさと曲がった形を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is a plate about the size of my palm, with one edge bent upward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the metal's size and bent shape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 触らずに離れた場所から見たのですね。今もそこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You observed from a distance without touching it, correct? Is it still there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十分前にはありました。写真は歩道の端から撮りました。見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目撃時刻と写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was there ten minutes ago. I took the photo from the edge of the sidewalk. I will show you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the sighting time and show the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を確認し、現場対応の担当へ伝えます。お名前と連絡先を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the photo and tell the field-response staff. May I have your name and contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号にお願いします。場所を確認する必要があれば、電話で説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を渡し追加の場所説明に応じると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please use this number. If the location needs confirming, I can explain by phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give contact details and offer additional location explanations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらで引き継ぎます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will pass it on. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海外宛てのはがきですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a postcard going abroad, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。住所はローマ字で書きました。国名は最後の行でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外宛て国名の行を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote the address in Roman letters. Is the last line right for the country name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check which line is for the destination country abroad. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後の行に、大きく国名を書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please write the country name clearly in large letters on the last line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書きました。差出人の住所は、宛先とどう分ければいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 国名を書き差出人との区別を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have written it. How should I distinguish the sender's address from the destination?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Write the country name and ask how to distinguish the sender. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 左上に小さめに書き、その前に差出人と分かる表示を付けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write it smaller at the upper left, preceded by a label showing that it is the sender.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この辺りに書きます。航空便で送りたいことも、はがきに書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 差出人位置を選び航空便表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write it around here. Should I also write on the postcard that I want airmail?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the sender position and ask about marking airmail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 航空便の表示をこちらで付けます。宛先と重ならない所を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will add the airmail marking. Leave space that does not overlap the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右上を空けました。絵の面には何も貼らないで送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示の余白を空け絵の面を保つ希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I left the upper right free. Can I send it without anything affixed to the picture side?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Leave marking space and request preserving the picture side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。表示と切手は住所面に付けます。料金はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will put the marking and stamp on the address side. This is the postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料金を払います。住所面だけに付けて、このはがきをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料金を払い住所面への貼付で差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pay. Please put them only on the address side and send this postcard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay and hand it in with markings affixed on the address side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりしました。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have accepted it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自動振込のお手続きについてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about automatic transfers, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。教室が八月は休みなので、八月分だけ振り込まないようにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 八月の月謝自動振込だけ休止できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The class is closed in August, so can I skip only the August transfer?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether only the August tuition automatic transfer can be suspended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在は毎月いつ、いくらのお振込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: When and how much do you currently transfer each month?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 毎月二十五日に六千円です。九月からは同じ額で再開したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 毎月の実行日と金額と九月再開の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Six thousand yen on the twenty-fifth each month. I would like to resume at the same amount from September.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the monthly execution date and amount and request resuming in September. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一回の休止が使えるか、契約内容を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the contract to see whether a one-time suspension is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 九月まで全部止まると困るので、八月だけという希望を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 継続停止ではなく八月一回休止と明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It would be a problem if everything stayed stopped through September, so please say I only want August skipped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clarify a single August suspension, not an ongoing stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。次の実行日と、変更の受付期限を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We will check the next execution date and the deadline for accepting changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 八月二十五日の前に手続きを終えたいです。今日は申込みまで相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 八月実行前の完了希望と当日の申込み相談を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to finish the procedure before August twenty-fifth. Can I discuss submitting the request today too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request completion before the August transfer and ask about applying today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当席でご相談いただけます。通帳と自動振込の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can discuss it at the coordinator's desk. Do you have the passbook and automatic-transfer copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方あります。八月だけ休止し、九月二十五日は六千円を振り込む設定を担当と確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料二点を提示し八月休止と九月実行の設定を担当確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have both. I will check the setting with the coordinator to skip only August and transfer six thousand yen on September twenty-fifth.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present both documents and confirm the August suspension and September execution settings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料を持って担当席へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the documents to the coordinator's desk. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: じゃがいもをお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。袋では多いので、二個だけ買えるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋より少ない二個の購入を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A bag is too many. Is there an option where I can buy just two?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request buying only two, fewer than a bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 隣の箱がばら売りです。大きさで価格が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The next box is sold individually. Prices differ by size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 煮物に使います。小さいものを二個選んで、この袋に入れていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 調理用途を伝えばら売りの袋を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will use them in a simmered dish. Can I choose two small ones and put them in this bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the cooking purpose and ask about the bag for individually sold items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 透明な袋をお使いください。ばら売り用のラベルをこちらで付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Use a clear bag. We will put the individual-sale label on it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二個選びました。皮に少し土が付いていますが、洗ってあるものもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二個を選び洗った商品の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have chosen two. There is a little soil on the skin. Are washed ones also available?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose two and ask whether washed ones are available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 洗ったものは右の袋入りだけです。ばら売りは土付きです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Only the bagged ones on the right are washed. The individually sold ones have soil on them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 量を優先して、土付きの二個にします。ラベルは袋の外に貼るのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 土付き少量を選びラベル位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will prioritize quantity and take the two with soil. The label goes outside the bag, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a small quantity with soil and check the label position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。会計では、そのラベルを読み取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. At checkout we scan that label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ラベルを貼りました。二個の袋をほかの野菜と一緒に会計へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ラベルを貼って会計へ運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have affixed the label. I will take the bag of two to checkout with my other vegetables.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Affix the label and say you will take it to checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どうぞレジへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please proceed to the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 掲示の許可を受けた案内をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a notice with permission to display it, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。来週の地域の演奏会です。受け取った許可番号はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 演奏会の掲示許可番号を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is next week's local concert. Here is the permission number I received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the concert display permission number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認できました。掲示板の中央の空いた所を使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Confirmed. You can use the open space in the center of the notice board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内は横長なので、透明なケースを横向きに使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 横長の案内に合わせ掲示ケースを横向きに使うと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: This notice is landscape-shaped, so I would like to use the clear case horizontally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request using the display case horizontally for the landscape notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ケースは横向きに開けられます。上の留め具を外してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The case opens horizontally. Undo the fastener at the top.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けました。下へ滑らないよう、案内の後ろに厚紙を入れていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ケースを開けずれ防止の厚紙を入れる可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I opened it. Can I put stiff paper behind the notice so it will not slide down?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Open the case and ask about inserting stiff paper to prevent slipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入れられます。ふたを閉める前に、端が枠に挟まっていないかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Before closing the cover, check that the edges are not caught in the frame.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 端は挟まっていません。イベントが終わった翌日に、私が外しに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内の端を確認し終了翌日の撤去を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The edges are not caught. I will come to remove it the day after the event ends.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the notice edges and offer removal the day after the event. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撤去は受付へ一声かけてからお願いします。掲示板は夕方五時まで使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell reception before removing it. The notice board is available until five in the afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 翌日の四時に受付へ寄ります。今はふたを閉めて留め具を戻しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四時の受付後撤去を決め現在のケース固定完了を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will stop at reception at four the next day. For now, I have closed the cover and fastened it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to remove it after checking in at four and report the case secured now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 掲示を確認しました。演奏会がよい一日になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have checked the display. I hope the concert is a lovely day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 指定席のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about a reserved seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この列車の窓側を予約しましたが、通路側に替えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓側指定席から通路側への変更を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I reserved a window seat on this train. Can I change to an aisle seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to change a reserved window seat to an aisle seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ列車でよろしいですか。今のお席を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On the same train? I will check your current seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ列車です。足を動かしやすいので、通路側を希望しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ列車を希望する理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the same train. I want an aisle seat because it is easier to move my legs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you want the same train and the aisle seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 六号車の通路側に空きがあります。同行の方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: An aisle seat is available in car six. Are you traveling with anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人です。今の席より後ろになりますが、荷物置場は近いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人乗車を答え新しい席から荷物置場までを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Alone. It is farther back than my current seat, but is the luggage area close?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you travel alone and ask the distance from the new seat to the luggage area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車両の端にあります。新しい席から三列ほどです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is at the end of the car, about three rows from the new seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこにします。今の切符は、変更のときに渡せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 候補席を選び旧券の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take it. Should I hand over my current ticket when changing it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the offered seat and ask what to do with the old ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらで変更後の券とお取り替えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will exchange it here for the changed ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い券を渡します。新しい券の六号車と通路側の席を確かめて受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧券を渡し新券の号車と位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand over the old ticket. I will check car six and the aisle seat on the new ticket before accepting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the old ticket and check the car and seat position on the new one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お席を変更しました。よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your seat has been changed. Have a pleasant trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どんな市民活動に興味をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of community activity interests you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもへの読み聞かせを手伝いたいです。初めてでも参加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めての読み聞かせ活動への参加を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to help read aloud to children. Can a first-timer join?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about joining a read-aloud activity for the first time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図書館の活動団体に、初めての方の見学日があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The library's activity group has an observation day for first-timers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず見学したいです。土曜日に行ける日があるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 土曜日の見学を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to observe first. Is there a day I can attend on Saturday?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a Saturday observation visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次の土曜日の午前に見学があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is an observation visit next Saturday morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行けます。本は、自分で選んで持っていくのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見学参加を決め本の持参を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can go. Should I choose and bring a book myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to observe and ask whether to bring a book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見学では持参不要です。活動する際の本選びは、団体と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: No book is needed for observation. You discuss book selection with the group when participating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 経験がないので、その練習方法も聞きたいです。見学の担当へ直接連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 練習の相談希望と担当への連絡方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have no experience, so I also want to ask how to practice. Can I contact the observation coordinator directly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request advice on practice and ask how to contact the coordinator. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの連絡先をお渡しします。申込みにはお名前と希望日を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will give you these contact details. To apply, give your name and preferred day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と次の土曜日の希望を伝えます。見学で、本選びと練習について質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見学申込みと当日の質問を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give my name and request next Saturday. During observation I will ask about choosing books and practice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to apply to observe and what to ask on the day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よい見学になりますように。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope it is a useful visit. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の準備は進んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you making progress packing your belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。借りた体温計とクッションは、どこへ返せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた体温計とクッションの返却先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Where should I return the borrowed thermometer and cushion?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to return the borrowed thermometer and cushion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 体温計はこちらで受け取ります。クッションはベッドに置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will take the thermometer here. Leave the cushion on the bed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 体温計を渡します。枕元にあった呼出しのボタンも、ベッドに残しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 体温計を渡し呼出しボタンの扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the thermometer. Should I also leave the call button that was by the pillow on the bed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hand over the thermometer and ask what to do with the call button. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、そのままです。ご自身の充電器と混ざっていないか、ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, leave it there. Check that it is not mixed up with your own charger.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 充電器は袋に入れました。病院の寝間着は、着替えたあとにどこへ置きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 私物の充電器を分け寝間着の返却先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put my charger in my bag. Where do I put the hospital pajamas after changing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate your own charger and ask where to return the pajamas. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口の返却袋に入れてください。今は着替えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Put them in the return bag by the entrance. Can you change now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。自分の服に着替えました。返却袋には、借りたタオルも入れていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着替え完了を伝えタオルの返却方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I have changed into my own clothes. Can I put the borrowed towel in the return bag too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report changing and ask how to return the towel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: タオルも入れて結構です。退院の説明書はお手元にありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can put the towel in too. You have your discharge instructions with you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明書は鞄に入れました。寝間着とタオルを返却袋へ入れて、受付へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明書を収納し返却を終え受付へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put the instructions in my bag. I will put the pajamas and towel in the return bag, then head to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pack the instructions, finish returning items and go to reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お荷物はそろいましたね。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your belongings are all ready. Please take care and get well soon.
